notes: Pa1d802b211 G4. Printed: '... search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Sorin, Vampire Lord ... If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Sorin, Vampire Lord is only in seat 0's graveyard; the library holds Card B and Card C over the fillers. Seat 0 takes the may and searches BOTH zones (option 0): Sorin comes from the graveyard to hand, and because the library was searched it is shuffled (8 cards, order unknown).
